description: This file defines the Vtiger_Profile class, providing API methods to manage CRM profiles, including initialization and deletion of profile settings for fields and modules, as well as logging.

classes.name: Vtiger_Profile
classes.description: Class providing static methods to manage CRM profile configurations, including field and module permissions.

methods.name: initForField
methods.description: Initializes profile setup for a specific field, inserting visibility and read-only permissions.

methods.name: deleteForField
methods.description: Deletes profile information related to a specific field.

methods.name: getAllIds
methods.description: Retrieves all existing profile IDs from the database.

methods.name: initForModule
methods.description: Initializes profile setup for a module, including permissions for actions.

methods.name: deleteForModule
methods.description: Deletes profile setup for a specific module.
